title: Compute headline physical quantities
action: Implement the formulas to compute the following three quantities using the provided parameters: (1) Relative inhomogeneity contribution factor f = (4 * ⟨n⟩ * (a*l)²) / (3π * ln(dq_D/2π)) using l=5 μm, a=0.1, ⟨n⟩=10¹¹ cm⁻², ln(dq_D/2π)=5. (2) Effective surface energy reduction Δα = (⟨n⟩ * d * G * b²) / (24π) for intergranular propagation (Eq. 8 with k=1, G=160 GPa, b=3×10⁻⁸ cm, ⟨n⟩=10¹⁰ cm⁻², d=50 μm). (3) Deviation from Hooke's law (percent strain deviation) as described in Section 6.3: using microcrack density 3×10⁵ cm⁻², N=60, compute the approximate relative deviation ≈ 7% from the given parameters (the deviation is (σ_nonlinear - σ_linear)/σ_linear expressed as percentage). Compute all three numbers and write them to /app/outputs/f_value.txt, each on a separate line in the order: f, Δα (in N/m), Hooke's law deviation (in %).
description: Three computed physical quantities: f, Δα, and Hooke's law deviation.
output_schema: Text file with three lines, each a floating-point number: first line is f, second line is Δα (N/m), third line is Hooke's law deviation (%).
